The soak-and-dry method: water thoroughly until it drains from the bottom, then leave it alone until the soil is bone dry. Summer: every 7–10 days. Monsoon: every 14–28 days, sometimes not at all. Winter: every 14–21 days. Use the toothpick test: push 2 cm into the soil, and only water if it comes out completely dry.

Remove from the nursery pot, shake off the old soil, and check the roots. Trim off anything damaged. Place in a new pot with fresh, well-draining mix. Don’t water for 3–5 days after planting; let the roots settle first. Then water as usual.
